definitions.explanation: Materials or substances occurring in nature that can be exploited for economic gain.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{天然|てんねん}{資源|しげん}に{乏|とぼ}しい。
examples.english: Japan is poor in natural resources.

examples.japanese: {限|かぎ}りある{資源|しげん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしなければならない。
examples.english: We must value our limited resources.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}は{重要|じゅうよう}な{資源|しげん}だが、いつか{枯渇|こかつ}すると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Oil is an important resource, but it's said it will someday be depleted.

notes:
{資源|しげん} refers to natural resources or any valuable materials that can be utilized.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然|てんねん}{資源|しげん} (natural resources)
- {人的|じんてき}{資源|しげん} (human resources)
- {水|みず}{資源|しげん} (water resources)
- {資源|しげん}を{活用|かつよう}する (to utilize resources)
- {資源|しげん}に{乏|とぼ}しい (poor in resources)
- {資源|しげん}に{恵|めぐ}まれる (to be blessed with resources)

RELATED TERMS:
- {資源|しげん}{ゴミ|ごみ} (recyclable waste/trash)
- {資源|しげん}{回収|かいしゅう} (resource collection/recycling)
